near_plane.guard: non-Shipping, IAIBench, EA_Core, requested camera route, IAICameraSlabBench, IAICameraRegression
near_plane.pose: EA_Camera far throughout; no near-wall tail
near_plane.pair: Same-index first2352 frames of near10 control-a. Both capture the complete default route section. No frame remapping or phase selection.
near_plane.D3D11_control: 09446 accepted control-a; binary differs only by this guarded far-only lever and its additive start receipt

floor.metric: max absolute RGB channel difference per pixel, full saved frame; every-frame256-bin histogram and above-level counts
floor.larger: Choose larger max_delta; if equal choose larger count. The count belongs to the selected maximum level; never import the lower-level count allowance.
floor.seal: Both measurements and chosen threshold sealed before D4 comparison; D3D12 also before positive launch. GO4 explicitly rejudges existing D3D11 positive.
floor.unlabelled: max_delta <= selected maximum AND count at selected maximum <= measured maximum count
floor.labelled: Above each measured floor by >1% of frame and more than its maximum-level noise count

order: D3D11 far-only near100; pair with accepted near10 prefix; seal; rejudge existing positive
D3D12-1280 baseline A and B; seal session floor
D3D12-1280 far-only near100; pair with baseline A prefix; seal larger floor
D3D12-1279 combined full2640 H4 textures G5
D3D12-1279 default-only2352; GO3 key/type and card reads
stop: Any failed measured gate; no threshold increase or retry
